ai_disruption_analysis.net_verdict: Concave to AI shock overall. The opportunity is real but capped (platform extension). The threat is fat-tailed and not yet priced. Via negativa: the danger is not visible in current financials -- exactly the turkey profile.
ai_disruption_analysis.fragile_or_antifragile: FRAGILE to AI disruption shock. The business is optimized for a world where humans need workflow software. AI agents that self-orchestrate make the product category optional. This is not a barbell -- it is a single-mode bet on enterprise inertia.
